description: Details required by conditions 5 (Construction Traffic Management Plan (CTMP)) and 6 (Professional management of engineering works) of planning permission 25/05237 (Alterations to the front elevation, including replacement of doors and installation of soil vent pipe; resurfacing of front paved areas; installation of rooflights and solar thermal panels; erection of two-storey rear infill extension at lower and upper ground floor levels, including reconfiguration of the lower ground lightwell; excavation and provision of basement extension below part of rear garden; alterations to the rear elevation including replacement of one door and two windows; removal of rear external boiler enclosure and associated flue attached to side of closet wing; installation of two external air conditioning condenser units within acoustic enclosures in rear garden; hard and soft landscaping to rear garden; and internal alterations, including works to front vaults)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
